## ✦ Before You Submit

Thank you for helping shape the future of **The Gaming Horizon**.

A strong feature request should explain:

```text
WHAT PROBLEM EXISTS?
        │
        ▼
WHY DOES IT MATTER?
        │
        ▼
WHAT COULD IMPROVE?
        │
        ▼
WHAT FEATURE IS PROPOSED?
        │
        ▼
WHAT WOULD SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?
```

Please confirm:

- [ ] I searched existing open issues.
- [ ] I searched relevant closed issues.
- [ ] I checked whether a similar feature has already been proposed.
- [ ] This request relates directly to The Gaming Horizon.
- [ ] I have kept this request focused on one main feature or capability.
- [ ] I understand that submitting a request does not guarantee implementation.
- [ ] I removed private or sensitive information.

## ✦ Project Scope

The Gaming Horizon is a **browser-first gaming ecosystem**.

A feature request should not assume that Gaming Horizon is currently:

```text
A CLOUD GAMING PLATFORM
A GAME STREAMING SERVER
A DOWNLOAD CLIENT
A DESKTOP GAME LAUNCHER
A QUEUE-BASED STREAMING SERVICE
```

unless maintained project documentation explicitly establishes such
functionality.

Please confirm:

- [ ] My request fits the documented browser-first direction of The Gaming Horizon.
- [ ] I have clearly separated current capabilities from proposed future functionality.

---

## ✦ Proposal vs Commitment

A feature request moves through evaluation:

```text
FEATURE IDEA
     │
     ▼
REVIEW
     │
     ▼
FEASIBILITY
     │
     ├───────────────┐
     │               │
     ▼               ▼
CONSIDER          DECLINE
     │
     ▼
DESIGN
     │
     ▼
PLAN
     │
     ▼
IMPLEMENT
     │
     ▼
VALIDATE
     │
     ▼
RELEASE
```

Submission does **not** mean that every stage will occur.

Possible outcomes include:

```text
ACCEPTED FOR DISCUSSION
NEEDS MORE INFORMATION
DEFERRED
DUPLICATE
OUT OF SCOPE
DECLINED
EXPERIMENTAL
PLANNED
IMPLEMENTED
```

---

## ✦ Evaluation Framework

A proposed feature may be evaluated against:

| Area | Question |
| --- | --- |
| **Value** | Does it solve a meaningful problem? |
| **Alignment** | Does it fit Gaming Horizon's direction? |
| **Usability** | Does it improve the experience? |
| **Accessibility** | Can it remain inclusive? |
| **Complexity** | Is the implementation justified? |
| **Performance** | Could it negatively affect the platform? |
| **Privacy** | Does it introduce new data concerns? |
| **Security** | Does it expand attack or permission surfaces? |
| **Maintainability** | Can it be supported long term? |
| **Extensibility** | Can it evolve without unnecessary redesign? |

---

```text
                         FEATURE

                            │
             ┌──────────────┼──────────────┐

             │              │              │
             └──────────────┼──────────────┘
                            ▼
                         LONGEVITY
```

A strong feature should create enough value to justify its complexity.

## ✦ Feature Request Quality

A strong feature request should be:

| Standard | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Problem-Driven** | Explains the need before the solution |
| **Focused** | Proposes one primary capability |
| **Valuable** | Identifies meaningful user or platform benefit |
| **Aligned** | Fits the Gaming Horizon direction |
| **Accessible** | Considers inclusive interaction |
| **Realistic** | Recognizes complexity and trade-offs |
| **Secure** | Avoids unnecessary security risk |
| **Maintainable** | Considers long-term ownership |
| **Truthful** | Does not present proposals as commitments |
| **Evolvable** | Can grow without unnecessary complexity |

---

## ✦ Final Checklist

Before submitting:

- [ ] I searched for similar feature requests.
- [ ] My title clearly identifies the proposed feature.
- [ ] I explained the problem or opportunity.
- [ ] I explained why the feature matters.
- [ ] I described the proposed experience.
- [ ] I identified the intended audience.
- [ ] I described expected benefits.
- [ ] I considered scope and minimum useful functionality.
- [ ] I considered accessibility where relevant.
- [ ] I considered responsive behavior where relevant.
- [ ] I considered privacy and security where relevant.
- [ ] I described alternatives or trade-offs where useful.
- [ ] I separated the proposal from existing functionality.
- [ ] I removed all sensitive information.
- [ ] I understand that submission does not guarantee implementation.
- [ ] I reviewed this feature request before submitting it.
